meal_plan.name: Weekly meal plan
guide: settings: cookingFor (1 to 30), toGroceries (true or false), groceriesListId (a checklist you may change)
entry meal: day (date), name, emoji, minutes, note, cookMemberId, ingredients (a list of names, when adding), recipeId (when adding: copies a kept recipe onto the day)
entry ingredient: mealId (when adding), name, atHome (true or false)
entry recipe: name, emoji, minutes, note, ingredients (a list of names)
show: any day of the week to show, as a date. Left out: this week.

chore_wheel.name: Chore wheel
guide: settings: people (member ids in the wheel's order; left out: everyone in the circle), stars ({stars, cents, currency, into} or null)
entry job: name, emoji, when (words), timesAWeek (1 to 7)
verb tick: jobId, done (true or false; left out: true), day (a date; left out: today)
show: any day of the week to show, as a date. Left out: this week.

time_capsule.name: Time capsule
guide: settings: opensOn (a date after today), forMemberIds (member ids; left out: everyone who sees it), countFrom (a date; left out: today), hideFromThem (when making it: true hides it from the people it is for until the day, with the shared hidden-from)
entry letter: text, title, note, fromName, seal (left out: true; false keeps it a draft only you see)
entry voice: mediaId (an audio upload), title, note, fromName, seal
entry photo: mediaId (a photo upload), title, note, fromName, seal; or parentId (a photos bundle)
entry photos: title, note (a bundle; add its photos as entries of kind photo with parentId)
verb seal: entryId (your own draft)

open_when.name: Open when…
guide: settings: forMemberId (who the letters are for)
entry letter: when (what the envelope says), emoji, text, mediaId (an audio upload), forwardOn (journey, or null)
verb open: entryId. The reader opens it, once; someone who may only look at the board may too.

birthday_interview.name: The birthday interview
guide: settings: forMemberId (who is interviewed; their page has to have a birthday)
entry question: text
entry answer: questionId, text, mediaId (an audio upload), age (left out: the age of this round)

said.name: Things they said
guide: settings: none
entry quote: text, saidByMemberId (or saidByName for someone outside the circle), day (left out: today), mediaId (an audio upload)
entries list: member (who said it), filter voice (only those with a recording), q (words)

same_spot.name: Same spot, every year
guide: settings: around (the day of the year it is usually taken, as MM-dd, or null)
entry photo: mediaId (a photo upload), year (left out: this year), day (left out: today), note

stories.name: Grandma's stories
guide: settings: tellerName (who tells the stories), sendsOn (a weekday in lower case; left out: sunday)
entry question: text, askedByMemberId (left out: you). When changing: text, transcript
entry photo: questionId, mediaId (a photo upload): a photo for a story
verb send_now: entryId (a waiting question goes out today)
entries list: kind question, filter told (only answered ones)

good_jar.name: The good things jar
guide: settings: none
entry slip: text, mediaId (a photo upload), what (note, photo or drawing; left out: by what was sent), fromMemberId (whose good thing it is; left out: yours), place, fromJourney
show: a year, to see that year's jar. Left out: this year.
entries list: filter with a year (2025) for that year's slips

doorframe.name: The doorframe
guide: settings: none
entry mark: memberId, heightMm (300 to 2500), day (left out: today), note, mediaId (a photo upload)
entry landmark: text (Up to Grandma Astrid's shoulder), heightMm
